diagnosis.strongestSharedFailureBoundary: The owner-bound scene failed operationally in NWN, but the exact failing scalar is not isolated. The native-complete x2_drider003 instance deliberately used Appearance row 15100, while the Hook Horror used the generated gameplay profile; no instance combined a native-complete creature profile with a native appearance/model. The current EE static trace additionally shows that the r43 TriMesh itself satisfies instance creation and final draw eligibility, so the failure cannot honestly be assigned to the seven-state rigid model family without an upstream resource/model-instance trace.
diagnosis.confirmedProcessDefect: H1 v20 was classified in code as a runtime-positive correctness witness although its only runtime image was a severely deformed blob. r43 was then required to reproduce that corrupt root, one-rigid-mesh and seven-state type-0 family. This was a false baseline.
diagnosis.retailDifferential: Exact readback of retail c_Direwolf, retail c_Horror and CEP R3 shows 42 local type-5 states, while CEP c_kocrachn inherits c_Horror. These are strong completeness references, not a proven no-draw gate. The current EE functions MdlNodeTriMesh::InternalCreateInstance, CreateInstanceTreeR, PartTriMesh::IsPartRenderable and PartTriMesh::Draw contain no requirement for SkinMesh, 42 states or a non-NULL supermodel. H1 v20 also reached the draw path with one rigid mesh and seven type-0 states, although it rendered corruptly.
diagnosis.notYetProvenScalar: No renderer scalar is established. Exact r43 readback has valid indices, winding, finite bounds, render=1, 2678 vertices and legal MDX streams. In the installed 2026-01-22 nwmain.exe, TriMesh instance creation copies render!=0 into the PartTriMesh enabled byte, the final renderability predicate accepts a nonzero vertex count, and Draw reaches a concrete render path after the same checks. The unresolved boundary is therefore before or around current-client resource resolution/model attachment, scene visibility, or owner-proof binding; it is not proved to be the animation-count or SkinMesh family.
diagnosis.auroraDecompilationFact: The creature load routine reads the complete instance state directly from the GIT structure. TemplateResRef is retained metadata; it does not merge a retail UTC profile into a sparse or minimal GIT creature at runtime.
diagnosis.retailResourceFact: Valid native UTCs vary in MaxHitPoints and SkillList length/ranks. MaxHitPoints=13 and exactly 28 zero-rank skills are not engine invariants.

conclusions.ownerCorrectionAccepted: The r43 test module contained corrupted generated model families and did not prove a working custom creature in NWN. The audit must not reinterpret that result as success, a wrong-module error or a mere proof-packet gap.
conclusions.rootCause: The exact artifact-level cause of complete NWN absence is not yet proven. What is proven is a process root cause: H1 v20 was promoted from a corrupt draw witness to a correctness baseline, the r43 control matrix omitted native-profile plus native-appearance, and internal readback was treated as engine acceptance. Current EE static analysis contradicts the stronger claim that r43 was rejected merely because it had one rigid TriMesh, seven type-0 states, NULL supermodel or no SkinMesh.
conclusions.implementedResolution: The production path now emits a controllerless Aurora root, direct-root SkinMesh, weighted skeleton, normalized unit scale, 42 distinct type-5 states, 23 gameplay callbacks and a clean one-creature ActiveMonsterBaseline test module. These are implemented completeness improvements, not a proven resolution of the observed r43 no-draw. The historical H1_SKINNED route is quarantined and rejected by the production Worker.
conclusions.verifiedScope: Core binary readback, deformation, geometry bounds, WASM, Studio, Worker, optimized browser readback, typecheck, strict Clippy and cargo test --workspace pass. This establishes offline implementation consistency only.
conclusions.unresolvedScope: No exact post-r43 candidate has been materialized and no claim of Toolset or NWN visibility is made. Only owner proof of one immutable MOD/HAK/model lineage can close runtime visibility and animation.
conclusions.resumeCondition: The modified MOD is now hash-bound. Before a new model iteration, close the missing A/B boundary on the same diagnosis lane: owner-test the already materialized stock-only generated-container diagnostic m2a_van02.mod or provide a candidate-bound NWN capture/log that proves whether a native-profile plus native-appearance creature is instantiated and visible. Only after that result may the exact minimal artifact delta be declared.
forbiddenShortcuts: Do not test or present the current r43 corrupted lineage as the fixed candidate.
Do not create r44, a new HAK, model resref, texture resref or appearance row merely because r43 is now hash-bound; the engine-level cause and minimal delta are still not diagnosed.
